description.ncbi_summary: This gene encodes a member of the ankyrin repeat and suppressor of cytokine signaling (SOCS) box protein family. Members of this family can interact with the elongin B-C adapter complex via their SOCS box domain and further complex with the cullin and ring box proteins to form E3 ubiquitin ligase complexes. They may function to mediate the substrate-recognition of the E3 ubiquitin ligases. A transcribed pseudogene of this gene has been identified on chromosome 15. Multiple transcript variants encoding different isoforms have been found for this gene. [provided by RefSeq, Dec 2009].

uniprot_function.text: Substrate-recognition component of a cullin-5-RING E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase complex (ECS complex, also named CRL5 complex), which mediates the ubiquitination and subsequent proteasomal degradation of target proteins (PubMed:25654263, PubMed:33268465). The ECS(ASB9) complex catalyzes ubiquitination of creatine kinases CKB and CKMT1A (PubMed:20302626, PubMed:22418839, PubMed:25654263, PubMed:33268465). [Isoform 2]: Does not interact with the Elongin BC complex, likely to be a negative regulator of isoform 1.
